before.lib/presenter.ex:
defmodule Presenter do
  @doc "Turn a gateway rejection into an access-denied message; gateway owns authorization."
  def submit(gateway, request) do
    case gateway.(request) do
      {:error, :unauthorized} -> "Access denied"
      {:ok, _receipt} -> "Sent"
    end
  end
end

after.test/presenter_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule PresenterTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "shows a gateway rejection" do
    gateway = fn _request -> {:error, :unauthorized} end
    assert Presenter.submit(gateway, :request) == "Access denied"
